title: 第七次记忆
style: 写实华语科幻短剧，火星基地冷色调，自然肤色，电影感光线，浅景深，竖屏构图
music_prompt: Melancholic ambient electronic instrumental, sparse piano notes over soft synth pads, lonely sci-fi atmosphere, slow tempo, no vocals

characters.name: 陈述
characters.appearance: 成年男性，火卫二基地第七区记忆站技师，屏幕冷光下的脸

characters.name: 苏黎
characters.appearance: 成年女性，灰色防护服，摘下面罩后脸很干净

shots.image_prompt: 大远景，火卫二穹顶基地外观，沙尘在穹顶外翻涌，远处塔灯被沙尘磨成一团模糊的橙色，暗红色天空
shots.motion_prompt: Slow cinematic push in toward the dome through swirling dust, fine particles drifting across the frame

shots.location: 第七区记忆站观察窗前
shots.image_prompt: 中景，陈述站在观察窗前关掉除霜器，透过玻璃望向停在气闸前的运输车，侧脸清晰，室内冷光，车身结着一层薄霜
shots.motion_prompt: Hand switches off the defroster panel, then slow dolly toward the frosted transport vehicle outside the window

shots.image_prompt: 中景，气压门咬合开启，泄出的白汽散开，穿灰色防护服的女人走进来摘下面罩，露出干净清晰的脸
shots.motion_prompt: White steam disperses softly, she lifts off her helmet visor, subtle handheld sway

shots.image_prompt: 近景，苏黎站在操作台后，手把一枚银色记忆芯片推向对面的陈述，面部清晰，嘴唇微张似要开口
shots.motion_prompt: Chip slides slowly across the metal tabletop toward camera, shallow depth of field
shots.speaker: 苏黎

shots.image_prompt: 特写，陈述的手指捏着银色芯片边缘，芯片编号被反复擦得发亮，他将芯片插入读卡槽，屏幕亮起
shots.motion_prompt: Macro shot, fingers turn the chip showing the worn serial number, insert it into the reader slot, screen glow rises

shots.image_prompt: 特写，屏幕画面：火星红沙起伏，一台旧式收音机，一个男人哼歌的模糊剪影，画面带杂讯闪动
shots.motion_prompt: Vintage screen flicker with static noise, red sand shimmering, humming silhouette swaying slightly, signal cuts off abruptly

shots.image_prompt: 近景，陈述侧头看向对面的女人，屏幕冷光映在他脸上，面部清晰，嘴唇微张似要说话
shots.motion_prompt: Slow turn of head toward her, subtle eye movement, ambient screen light shifting
shots.speaker: 陈述

shots.image_prompt: 近景，苏黎站在操作台另一侧直视陈述，面容平静而坚决，冷光下脸很干净，嘴唇微张似要开口
shots.motion_prompt: She holds a steady gaze, slight forward lean, camera slowly pushes in
shots.speaker: 苏黎
shots.dialogue: 我要把它找回来。上传那天，我少拷了一段。

shots.image_prompt: 特写，苏黎的眼睛，瞳孔在冷光下轻轻收缩了一下
shots.motion_prompt: Extreme close-up of her eye, pupil contracts subtly, cold light reflection trembling

shots.image_prompt: 中近景，陈述隔着操作台看向苏黎，神情严肃，面部清晰，嘴唇微张，背景是暗下去的屏幕
shots.motion_prompt: Static locked shot, his gaze fixed on her, faint screen flicker in background
shots.speaker: 陈述
shots.dialogue: 那是别人的记忆。你确定要偷别人记忆？

shots.image_prompt: 远景，沙暴夜空，最后一艘补给船被推得偏离航线，尾焰在尘埃里拉出一道很淡的线
shots.motion_prompt: Supply ship drifting slowly off course, faint engine trail gradually fading through blowing dust

shots.image_prompt: 特写，苏黎的手按在银色芯片上，指节泛白
shots.motion_prompt: Static close-up, fingers slowly tightening over the chip, knuckles whitening

shots.image_prompt: 近景，苏黎目光低垂看向台面上的芯片，面部清晰可见，嘴唇微张，冷光落在灰色防护服肩头
shots.motion_prompt: She looks down at the chip, slow subtle rise of chest before speaking, camera drifts closer
shots.speaker: 苏黎
shots.dialogue: 他是我父亲。他死在地球那天，我在火星。

shots.image_prompt: 特写，苏黎缓缓抬起眼望向陈述，眼中含着隐忍的泪光，面部清晰，嘴唇微张
shots.motion_prompt: She slowly raises her eyes toward him, slight chin lift, holding back tears, gentle push in
shots.speaker: 苏黎
shots.dialogue: 我只想再看一次他唱歌的样子。

shots.image_prompt: 中景，陈述把芯片从读卡槽退出放回台面，看着她很久没有说话，面部清晰，屏幕的光落在他脸上像另一种日落
shots.motion_prompt: He slides the chip back across the table, long silent stare, warm screen light flickering across his face

shots.image_prompt: 特写，苏黎抬起眼望向镜头方向，冷光在她瞳孔里碎成两颗小太阳，面部清晰，嘴唇微张似要开口
shots.motion_prompt: She lifts her gaze into the cold light, reflections splitting into two tiny suns in her pupils, slow push in
shots.speaker: 苏黎
shots.dialogue: 那你就照着我说的，把它重新写一遍吧。
